item.title: Second Brain for Engineers: Notes Are Storage, Systems Compute
item.description: Overload isn’t volume — it’s unresolved inputs never resurfacing when useful. A second brain externalizes thinking so the biological one spends less on storage and more on interpretation, connection, and output: not a note app, but a loop turning scattered inputs into reusable thinking.

item.title: PKM vs RAG vs Wiki vs Memory: Four Knowledge Jobs, Four Systems
item.description: PKM, wikis, RAG, and AI memory get discussed as rivals solving one problem. They don’t. PKM helps humans think, wikis preserve shared knowledge, RAG retrieves for machines, memory gives agents continuity. Mix them up and you get personal scratch in the wiki, sourceless-truth RAG, database-pretending memory, and automation-bloated PKM.
